clips.title: The story
paras: At a camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, Lars struggles to survive Duskwood with Sven Yorgen. The woods around them hold beasts, undead, and worgen.

Lars keeps to a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, away from the uncertain safety of Darkshire. Duskwood is dangerous, and the surrounding woods hold ferocious beasts, undead, and worgen. He stays close to Sven Yorgen, trying to survive in the hostile forest.
Starving dire wolves prowl the woods around Lars and Sven's camp. Lars cannot keep watch or drive them off alone, so he depends on travelers to thin their packs before the predators overrun the camp.
